specs.title: Explicit certus-to-certus KV cache transfer over a symmetric RDMA endpoint

drifted.spec_text: A transfer request MUST carry: a context ID, the destination's rkey, base address, per-entry size, and a list of (block key, landing slot index) pairs.
drifted.actual: OP_FETCH carries a header with context_id, then per entry (key u64, addr u64, size u32, rkey u32); no base address, no slot index. Key Entities TransferContext/RemoteRegion also stale.

drifted.spec_text: send-queue credits — in-flight RDMA writes per connection
drifted.actual: Send credits are taken by every send-queue request, message SENDs included.

drifted.spec_text: The deadline MUST run from when the request is sent
drifted.actual: Clock starts when the chunk is encoded into the outbox after a message credit is taken, before flush_outbox posts it (which may wait on a send credit).

drifted.spec_text: remote-lookup MUST NOT be modified as part of delivering P1.
drifted.actual: The branch adds bounce-reserve and read_to_bounce impls to remote-lookup's pub seams module, forced by interface growth (T083).

drifted.spec_text: The endpoint MUST answer a request it cannot process with an explicit protocol error reply ... never with silence.
drifted.actual: An OP_FETCH over quota or before OP_HELLO, a malformed or duplicate OP_HELLO, and an OP_ERROR naming a kind other than OP_FETCH all tear the connection down instead of being answered.

drifted.spec_text: A request that cannot be processed draws a protocol error reply naming the offending opcode
A requester MUST respect the peer's maximum request size rather than its own.
drifted.actual: Chunks to min(peer max_entries, local MAX_ENTRIES=340); also fails the connection on max_entries == 0 (unspecced).

drifted.spec_text: Message credits are per direction ... (contract: stats() snapshots the credit domains per direction)
drifted.actual: TransferStats.requests_outstanding_outbound and requests_in_service_inbound are never written; they always read 0. Session::outbound()/inbound() hold the real values but only test code reads them.

drifted.spec_text: The reply deadline runs from when the request is sent, not from the fetch call
drifted.actual: Same as FR-016: clock starts at outbox enqueue.

drifted.spec_text: The existing remote-lookup test layer and the initiator's loopback_push_writes_into_remote_buffer hardware loopback test pass against this endpoint with messaging unused.
drifted.actual: The loopback scenario is reproduced in this crate's own loopback_test.rs (T055); the remote-lookup test layer has never run against this endpoint (needs T065, out of scope).

drifted.spec_text: The duplicated verbs FFI layer is defined once.
drifted.actual: This crate has one copy; the two predecessor copies remain until T066, so the workspace has three.

other_drift.spec_text: TransferEndpointError::IncompatiblePeer — fetch returns it if the peer's version range does not intersect
other_drift.actual: Never constructed. A non-intersecting OP_HELLO tears down; waiting fetches fail as Transport('connection ... was lost'); diagnostic only in the log.

other_drift.spec_text: fetch: NotInitialized if no landing region is registered
US1: destination reserves unpublished slots in its own memory tier; contract: landing region is in practice the memory tier's own pool
other_drift.actual: The pool is registered REMOTE_WRITE at initialize but no public API exposes its rkey; register_landing_region refuses any range overlapping the pool. Only test code (cfg(test) PoolKey) can land into the pool.

other_drift.spec_text: bounce_alloc(&self, len) -> Result<*mut u8, BounceError>; bounce_free(&self, ptr, len)
other_drift.actual: bounce_alloc -> Result<BounceLease, BounceError>; bounce_free(&self, lease: BounceLease)

other_drift.spec_text: Until initialize succeeds, every ITransferEndpoint method returns NotInitialized
protocol_faults: Protocol error replies received or sent; wire-protocol Bad replies: counts it as a protocol fault
other_drift.actual: Only a received OP_ERROR increments protocol_faults; sending one does not (asserted by test); a bad-reply teardown increments nothing.

other_drift.spec_text: version: Zero and ignored for OP_HELLO/OP_ERROR
other_drift.actual: Must be exactly 0 for all frozen kinds incl. OP_HELLO_REPLY; non-zero refused as UnsupportedVersion.

other_drift.spec_text: each end must have at least one reply-reserve buffer and one quota buffer posted before the connection is established (also T080)
other_drift.actual: Receives are posted in bring_up on TableEvent::Up, after establishment; the initiator's OP_HELLO can RNR-stall, absorbed only by infinite RNR retry.
Any host string, bracketed IPv6, no resolution ("host:port").

other_drift.spec_text: the sender's highest supported version for that kind
other_drift.actual: The sender's highest protocol version, or 0 if the kind is unknown; there are no per-kind versions.

other_drift.spec_text: T031 [X]: context table in src/message.rs: TransferContext = context id, peer, key list, landing slots, outstanding-entry count, deadline
other_drift.actual: No TransferContext; tables are Conn.outbound/Fetch/Chunk in endpoint.rs.

other_drift.spec_text: CLAUDE.md Current state: 'disconnect and stats work; the rest say which task they land in. The verbs side of the seam is T053.'
other_drift.actual: Every method is implemented; T053 is done.
